description: Category 1 (numerical) questions with integer answers, authored from the challenge sample questions and reference images in questions/livingroom_3/questions.pdf. Objects are restricted to salient, visually verifiable furniture and decor so a human can confirm every answer from the scene. Each question carries a machine-readable spec that scripts/eval/verify_benchmark2.py re-evaluates against the iref_vla object bounding boxes.
notes: Q01 is the official Category 1 sample question from questions/livingroom_3/questions.pdf; its answer (2) is the answer printed in the PDF.
difficulty: easy = single salient object class; medium = one relation; hard = two chained relations.

Only large, unambiguous objects are counted. Spot lights, candles, small decorations and structural classes (wall/floor/ceiling) are excluded because they are too small or too abstract to ground reliably.
'Chair' spans three different shapes here (six black dining chairs, a red armchair and a red ottoman), so every chair question is anchored to the dining table rather than counting the class outright.
'Potted plant' is avoided as a count target: six are labelled, ranging from a floor planter to tabletop succulents, which a human would count inconsistently.
object_ids lists supporting iref_vla scene-graph ids for auditing; SAM3 should use target_objects.

questions.question: How many photos are on the TV cabinet?
questions.evidence: Two framed photos (13, 61) stand on the long TV cabinet 41.

questions.question: How many windows are in the room?
questions.evidence: A long window wall on the west side (9) and the glazed corner by the dining table (47).

questions.question: How many speakers are in the room?
questions.evidence: Two speakers (0, 22) sit on the wall shelf above the TV.

questions.question: How many columns are in the room?
questions.evidence: Two full-height square columns (38, 79) along the west side of the room.

questions.question: How many pillows are on the couch?
questions.evidence: Four patterned pillows (11, 75, 89, 96) lie on couch 44.

questions.question: How many books are stacked on the TV cabinet?
questions.evidence: A stack of five books (24, 25, 26, 27, 28) sits on TV cabinet 41; book 77 is on the wall shelf 1.2 m higher and book 10 is on the sideboard.

questions.question: How many side tables are next to the couch?
questions.evidence: Two dark side tables (42, 64) stand at the end of couch 44; the dining table is 4 m away.

questions.question: How many chairs are around the table with the red tablecloth on it?
questions.evidence: Dining table 72 carries red tablecloth 23 and is surrounded by six black chairs (30, 39, 74, 94, 103, 104); the red armchair and ottoman are 6 m away.

questions.question: How many decorative balls are in the bowl on the dining table?
questions.evidence: Bowl 36 sits on dining table 72 and holds three decorative balls (33, 34, 35); the second bowl in the scene is on a stool.

questions.question: How many vases are on the side tables next to the couch?
questions.evidence: Vases 43 and 105 stand on side table 64 beside couch 44; the other vases are on the coffee table and on the floor.
